author: Dan Raby
title: Deputies searching for naked driver after Upson County incident - NewsBreak
text:
By Dan Raby ,
5 hours ago
Authorities in Upson County are looking for a driver accused of hitting the road without any clothes in the middle of the day.
Officials with the Upson County Sheriff's Office say deputies were called to Yatesville Highway around 3 p.m. on Tuesday after receiving a public decency complaint.
An employee working traffic control as a company did utility work by the road said they spotted a man who appeared to be shirtless driving a Toyota.
The man approached the vehicle and called out to the worker about the construction, police say. When she got closer to the Toyota, the woman said he realized the man was naked.
"He inquired about how to get a job with the construction company saying that he was 'tired of warehouse work,'" Upson County Sheriff Dan Kilgore wrote on Facebook.
The man was described as a white male with a buzz haircut and thick lens glasses who "resembles the cartoon character Bobbie Hill from the 'King of the Hill' series," officials said. He was believed to be driving a dark gray Toyota Scion with a 1776 Georgia tag.
If you have any other information about the case, call Upson County Sheriff's Office at 706-646-7936.
